issues.where: the central rock peak and its snow-covered flank (also visible in set-B-02.png)
issues.what: the spire reads as a low-poly faceted mesh with horizontal banding, stretched textures, a narrower blunted tip, white bulbous lumps along the right ridge, and almost none of the snowy left slope seen in the target
issues.fix: rebuild the peak with jagged, high-resolution alpine rock geometry, remove the horizontal stepping and ridge lumps, and restore heavy snow cover down the left flank and ledges

issues.where: the translucent violet ribbons streaming from the peak
issues.what: the streamers look like flat cut-out plastic strips with jagged alpha holes and thin uniform squiggly tethers rather than delicate wind-whipped translucent membranes
issues.fix: replace them with gossamer, organically torn translucent sheets that catch specular rim light, fine droplets, and sparks along their edges

issues.where: the distant mountain spires, cloud sea, and orange horizon on the right
issues.what: the background peaks are blocky low-poly slabs over a flat grey surface, and the sunset clouds show unnatural wavy distortion instead of receding spires rising from a volumetric sea of clouds
issues.fix: sculpt sharp, curved distant peaks receding into atmospheric haze, replace the flat base with layered volumetric clouds, and remove the wavy ripple from the sunset band

issues.where: the cave walls, ceiling, and hanging icicles (also visible in set-B-04.png)
issues.what: the cavern walls have heavily stretched, blurry procedural noise instead of rocky layered stone and glossy ice, and the icicles are rigid, opaque grey spikes lined up like a comb
issues.fix: add sculpted rocky cavern geometry with wet, reflective ice coatings and replace the uniform spikes with irregular, translucent, light-catching icicles along the arch

issues.where: the landscape seen outside the cave mouth
issues.what: the distant mountains are flat grey polygonal wedges with a sawtooth snow edge and a tiny floating hook, lacking the jagged distant spire, wind-streamers, blowing snow, and trail of footprints
issues.fix: rebuild the exterior valley and distant spire with detailed snow-covered landforms, add blowing snow haze, distant wind-streamers, and footprints leading out into the snow

issues.where: the overall cave lighting and mood
issues.what: the interior is flatly and brightly lit in washed-out cool grey, losing the deep cavern shadows, warm stone undertones, and strong violet storm rim light from the entrance
issues.fix: darken the cave interior with natural shadow falloff from the mouth, restore subtle warm rock tones on the upper left wall, and add stronger purple-blue rim lighting from the storm sky

issues.where: the lightning strike point and surrounding air (also visible in set-B-02.png)
issues.what: the strike produces a soft airbrushed glow with very few sparks, no billowing steam plume, and no driving sleet or snow in the air, and fails to light the rock crags below
issues.fix: add a bright burst of warm orange sparks, a lit steam plume behind the summit, wind-driven snow streaks across the air, and directional purple bounce light down the upper crags

issues.where: the out-of-focus foreground ridge on the left
issues.what: it appears as a smooth, straight-edged dark brown wedge with mottled spots and no snow
issues.fix: give the foreground ridge an irregular rocky silhouette with out-of-focus snow patches matching the target's scale and depth of field

issues.where: the cave floor and lower foreground framing
issues.what: the framing snowy foreground ledge on the bottom left and rock on the bottom right are missing, and the ice floor is a smooth uniform sheet rather than rough, slushy, wet ice with varied specular highlights
issues.fix: restore the out-of-focus foreground ledge and right-hand rock, and break up the ice floor with slush pockets, snow drifts, and irregular wet reflections

issues.where: the fur texture, frost, and ground contact of the huddled creatures (also visible in set-B-03-b.png)
issues.what: the fur reads as flat overlapping grey-white strips with hard edges, lacking clumped frost and snow buildup, and the resting bodies sit lightly with weak contact shadows
issues.fix: replace the flat fur cards with denser, matted hair encrusted with snow and frost clumps, and deepen contact shadows where the bodies rest on the cave floor
